about_the_game:
You are participant in mysterious game show. Your hosts want you to entertain the audience, and how can you entertain anyone without risking your life? That's right - you can't!

Key Features: 

  • Immersive experience: Atmospheric liminal environment. No cutscenes or other ways to take controls away from you

  • Psychological horror: PTSD, phobias will never let you go

  • Some stories based on real events: Human cruelty has no limits

  • Cyberpunk setting: 

  • Interesting plot: The plot will evolve with each level.

Gameplay:

4 Episodes - 4 Trials

Pilot Episode: Magic Quiz Lottery - "Answer questions and win the prizes"

Episode 2: Rock Paper Scissors - "Paper beats rock. Money beats pain."

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2 GB)

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4–6 GB)

short_description: Drowning in debt and desperate for a way out, you're invited to a mysterious game show promising untold wealth. But behind the beautiful cover lies a cruel truth: the prize is real — and so is the price of failure.
